notes:
I checked the Status and Position sections of all 30 entries against the tree at cb398676 (228 claims: 198 ok, 25 findings, 5 unverifiable). I changed no tracked file. My only file is the probe script /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/L6a/probe.jl, which I ran three times; the first two runs failed on a bug in my own helper. I also ran design/tools/check_refs.jl from W/design. It is read-only, it found every citation and anchor resolved, and the worktree stayed clean afterwards. Every entry is ratified and none carries a superseded → chain.

Of the 25 findings, 21 are drifts that an annotation inside the same entry already records, at log.md:875, 921, 1830, 2834, 3449, 8987, 8991, 9488, 18690, 18755, 18762, 18943, 19426, 19478 and 19805. Under log rule 1 they need no edit, and the verifier may want to dismiss them as already annotated.

Four drifts have no annotation, and each fix proposes one:
- L6a-083: D-141 says `init_x`, which D-267 renamed `x_init`.
- L6a-090: D-220's 8991 annotation names `x_derivative`, but D-279 later shortened it to `x_deriv`.
- L6a-100: D-220's 'what stays' list (`init_x`, `init_s`, `init_m`, `input_types`, `output_types` and the connection declarations) was renamed by D-267, D-279 and D-314, and no annotation records it.
- L6a-177: D-454 says the descriptor carries no time quantity. Since D-467 the deployment descriptor carries `dt_frame`, `dt_base`, `h_max` and `h_min` (src/descriptor.jl:65-67).

The 5 unverifiable claims are about PIVector and the gear's strut.wow wiring. These are FlightPhysics names outside this repo. Redstone's own analog, Integrator(; reset = true) at src/library.jl:911-965, matches the policy D-141 describes.

How the leads ended:
- In finding rows: the D-220 rename names (rows 090, 091, 092, 094, 097, 100), init_s and init_m (row 107), and init_x (row 083).
- In ok rows: localize (087) and upward/downward/both (089), as the names of a removed keyword and an unbuilt feature.
- Unverifiable: PIVector and strut.wow (080, 085).

The ptr and why counts are estimates and are not listed one by one: D-141's four spec-pointer sentences, D-001's two entry pointers, and the vocabulary and rationale sentences of D-001, D-019, D-053, D-121, D-220, D-231 and D-361.
